fact: ACSI, which designed and built SIFEC, handed its operating technical documents to the territorial administration directorate on 22 September 2026, with data centralisation, user training and deployment still listed as next steps (Dépêches de Brazzaville/ADIAC).

The interior minister told the Senate on 7 August 2026 that digitisation of civil-status acts through the integrated civil-status management system project is the structural response to fraud (Datsoue News).

A workshop closing on 20 February 2026 validated 17 recommendations for the SIFEC software, the main one being to provide the human, material and financial resources needed to deploy the platform (Ministry of Finance communiqué).
The Ministry of Finance reports a final validation workshop (18-20 February 2026) on the SIFEC civil-status software, developed by ACSI, with modules for births, marriages and deaths.
